title: Veo 3 Video Generator: Create with Veo 3.1 Fast
description: Create an 8-second video from text or an image with Veo 3.1 Fast on Lanta AI. Configure your prompt and format in one browser-based workflow.
publicHtml:
Veo 3.1 Fast on Lanta AI

Create videos with Veo 3.1 Fast

Turn a written scene or a source image into an 8-second video with Veo 3.1 Fast. Describe the action, framing and sound cues you want, then review the available settings before generating.

Lanta AI provides access to the model through its own creative workflow and is not an official Google service.

Current model access

Veo 3 search intent, Veo 3.1 Fast generation

Veo 3 is a family of video-generation models from Google. On this Lanta AI page, the available generator is configured for Veo 3.1 Fast, a later model option in that family.

This distinction matters: references to Veo 3 explain the model family and search term, while the settings and output claims on this page describe the Veo 3.1 Fast option that is actually available here.

Image to video

Veo 3 questions

What to know before generating with the model available on this page.

Which Veo version is available on this page?

The generator on this page is configured for Veo 3.1 Fast. The page also uses the broader Veo 3 name because that is how many people refer to and search for this model family.

Can I create a video from text or an image?

Yes. You can begin with a text prompt or upload one source image. The available fields and format options are shown directly in the generator.

How long is a generated video?

The Veo 3.1 Fast option on this page is configured to create an 8-second video.

How does audio work with Veo 3.1 Fast?

This page does not expose an audio on/off switch for Veo 3.1 Fast. Add any desired dialogue, ambience or sound cues to your prompt; the model handles audio as part of generation.

How many credits does a Veo video use?

The generator displays the current credit estimate for your selected settings before submission. Check that estimate because product costs can change.

Is Lanta AI an official Google Veo service?

No. Lanta AI is an independent creative platform that provides access to supported video models; it is not an official Google service or a statement of partnership with Google.
